interface.name: rix_surface_effects_manager_v1
interface.description: Optional extension to KDE blur. Shapes are surface-local logical coordinates. Rendering uses analytic coverage, while wl_region remains the input contract. No widget names or desktop layout are part of this protocol.

interface.name: rix_surface_effects_v1
interface.description: clear and add_rectangle construct a replacement region. commit stages it for the next wl_surface.commit. At most 16 shapes are retained. Their coverage is combined by maximum, so overlapping shapes never apply an effect twice. Opacity is coverage strength, independent of the material's color opacity.

request.name: add_clipped_rectangle

description.summary: Intersect a moving shape with a fixed viewport

request.description: Geometry and radius describe the complete shape before clipping. The clip rectangle is surface-local, axis-aligned, and does not deform it. All dimensions must be positive; invalid shapes are ignored.
